scope: Relocatable release installation and full release gates on Linux, macOS, and Windows

red_evidence.reason: the distribution omitted LICENSE and readmes, and CI had no three-operating-system matrix
Windows checkout converted source files to CRLF
Windows correctly retained LF, then exposed SQLite cleanup ordering in the complete regression suite

assertions: the release runs from a non-ASCII clean home using Node.js 24 with no Bun dependency
SQLite uses the Node.js built-in module and requires no install-time native compilation
CLI doctor, workspace persistence, review rendering, delivery export, backup, and reopen work from dist
the release manifest contains relative POSIX paths and no development-machine home path
LICENSE, both readmes, third-party notices, templates, schemas, skills, and runtime source are packaged
Git checkout preserves LF source on all runners
test cleanup closes database handles before removing temporary directories on Windows
all three operating systems execute the same full 225-test regression and release gates

review.kind: primary-agent code and evidence review after two real Windows CI failures

evidence_boundary: Automated OS portability is verified; real Codex, ZCode, Kimi, external provider, and publishing-account validation is not inferred.
